profile.bio: Responsible for the marigold seed: handling, germination, the growing guide and seasonality. Sees the dead-marigold-with-no-remedy pain point as the most fixable root cause in the whole list, and has teamed up with the CX Lead on a combined guide-plus-remedy fix. Sides with the Founder on never publishing an invented germination rate, which is UNKNOWN, and insists on running a real germination test instead.
profile.personality: Methodical, evidence-driven, patient, protective of the plant, plain-spoken
profile.stance: Root-cause fixer: the dead-seed problem gets fixed first through a printed growing guide, better seed handling and possibly spare seeds (a proposal that has to be costed with Finance). Refuses to state any germination figure until a real test has been run, and flags seasonality as a risk to Archive 002 timing.
